panel.title: AI report assistant

panel.save_first: Save the report before using AI.
panel.disabled: The AI report assistant is turned off by an administrator.
panel.focus_placeholder: e.g. Learned nested loops; found and fixed bugs independently

panel.preview_hint: Names, phone numbers and other personal data are replaced with codes such as [學生A] before sending and restored afterwards.
panel.unresolved: Some codes were not restored: {tokens}. They are contact details (kept out of parent reports) or names that could not be matched; please edit them by hand.
panel.replace_confirm_message: The current learning report will be replaced by the AI draft. You can restore it from version history.

panel.generating_status: Generating; sections appear as they are written…

warnings.thin_class_notes: Class notes are brief; consider adding today's focus

notice.title: Before you start
notice.what_is_sent: Sent: this lesson's details, ratings, class notes, your report draft, the last 3 reports and anything you add.
notice.deidentified: Names, schools, phone numbers, emails and ID numbers are replaced with codes before sending and restored afterwards.
notice.providers: Content is processed by the AI service your administrator configured (or your own account).
notice.logged: Each generation's de-identified content, model and the parts you use are recorded.
notice.responsibility: AI drafts are suggestions; check them before sending to parents.

errors.AI_DISABLED: The AI report assistant is turned off.
errors.AI_NOTICE_REQUIRED: Please read and acknowledge the usage notice first.
errors.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The selected model is no longer available; choose another source.
errors.AI_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The site quota is used up.
errors.AI_SECRET_KEY_MISSING: Credential encryption is not configured on the server; this source is unavailable.
errors.AI_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: This source's credential is invalid; choose another source or update the credential.
errors.AI_DEIDENTIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: De-identification is unavailable, so nothing was sent to protect personal data.
errors.AI_DEIDENTIFICATION_INCOMPLETE: Some personal data could not be removed, so nothing was sent.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI service returned an error. Try again later or use another source.
errors.AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT: The AI took too long to respond. Try again later.
errors.AI_GENERATION_CANCELLED: Generation stopped; no quota was used.
errors.AI_STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection was interrupted. Please retry.
errors.AI_SAVE_REQUIRED: The report has not been saved yet. Save it, then generate.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to use AI on this report.
errors.NETWORK_OFFLINE: You are offline. Reconnect and try again.
errors.AI_UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.AI_OAUTH_EXPIRED: The sign-in expired. Connect OpenRouter again.
errors.AI_OAUTH_FAILED: OpenRouter did not accept the sign-in. Please try again.
errors.AI_EMPTY_OUTPUT: The AI returned an empty draft; no quota was used. Try again or use another model.
errors.AI_PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your ChatGPT plan allowance or this site's weekly limit is used up. Switch source or try again later.
errors.AI_CHATGPT_PLAN_NOT_GRANTED: This sign-in did not grant plan usage. It needs ChatGPT Plus or Pro and consent to use the plan allowance.
errors.AI_CHATGPT_NOT_CONFIGURED: Connecting a ChatGPT account is not available on this site yet.
errors.AI_GENERATION_INTERRUPTED: This generation was interrupted (the server restarted or it took too long); no quota was used. Please try again.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: The AI service is rate limiting this model (common for free models). Try again later or use another model.
errors.AI_MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: This model does not support this kind of request. Use another model.
errors.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The AI reply could not be read as a report; no quota was used. Try again or use another model.
errors.AI_DATA_POLICY: Your OpenRouter privacy settings do not allow this model (common for free models). Allow the free models' data policy under OpenRouter → Settings → Privacy, or use a paid model.
